startup_environment.cause: The prior AndroidWorld emulator process was transport-visible but its gRPC and ADB shell paths were unresponsive. The bundled stop script then waited on the stale ADB path.
startup_environment.recovery: The two r9 runner processes and only the command-line-verified AndroidWorldAvd emulator processes were stopped. A cold emulator start and independent AndroidWorld smoke passed before invocation 2.
startup_environment.data_integrity: The startup failure was retained in startup_environment_audit.json and did not create an episode or consume a model call.

results.diagnosis: The r9 exact-target guard correctly rejected both the initial and repaired long-press before execution. Accessibility proved that the exact task-literal filename was not visible and that the proposed coordinate was nearest to nature_sounds_2023_02_11.mp3. The executor nevertheless returned the identical long-press in its only bounded repair, so the run terminated safely without moving the distractor or reaching the destination stage.

guard_assessment.successful_invariant: A consequential Files long-press cannot execute when the nearest full accessibility filename differs from the task-literal filename.
guard_assessment.r8_regression_status: The specific r8 wrong-file mutation is prevented before actuation.
guard_assessment.unexercised_in_r9: The refined post-destination commit policy was not reached and therefore remains unit/integration-tested but not live-validated.
guard_assessment.remaining_failure: The single model repair did not convert a semantic action rejection into a different recovery action.

repair_prompt_assessment.conflict: The generic repair prompt says to correct the previous response format only, even when VALIDATION_ERROR rejects the action semantics rather than its JSON shape.
repair_prompt_assessment.missing_runtime_fact: The user-facing validation string did not state that exact_text_visible was false or identify the nearest mismatched full filename, although both facts were present in the audit record.
repair_prompt_assessment.observed_effect: The model repeated the same valid JSON long-press with the same coordinates, and the guard correctly rejected it a second time.

next_hypothesis.problem: A schema-oriented one-repair prompt cannot reliably repair a semantically unsafe action when its opening instruction tells the executor to preserve the action choice.
next_hypothesis.generic_fix: Classify guard validation errors as semantic action rejections. For such errors, explicitly require a materially different GUI action rather than a format-only correction. Render the exact-selection assessment into the error: name the nearest mismatched filename and state whether the exact target is visible. When it is not visible, require a non-long-press navigation action such as Search, a view-mode change, or scrolling.
next_hypothesis.methodological_boundary: Do not inject evaluator state, silently rewrite coordinates, or grant extra repair calls. The repaired action must still be generated by the frozen executor from the task literal, screenshot, and current accessibility-derived validation evidence.
next_hypothesis.test_requirement: Add unit coverage for semantic-versus-format repair wording and an integration case where an initial wrong same-prefix long-press is repaired into a different Search/navigation action within the existing one-repair budget.

decision: Preserve r9 and do not launch the formal eight-cell Gate E. A separate r10 may make the repair contract semantic-error-aware while retaining the exact-target guard and the one-repair limit.
